name: ultimate-workflow
description: Plan-first, test-first workflow for AI coding assistants. Five phase commands (plan, tests, build, review, harvest) that each run in a fresh context with scoped tools, seven skills (feature workflow, greenfield bootstrap, and five architecture skills for design review, greenfield design, modularity, resilience and operability), and opt-in lifecycle gates. Behavioral principles derived from Andrej Karpathy observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
